name: SexWithPlayer
description: Starts an OStim scene between the speaking NPC and the player, once the player confirms.
note: Replaces the Mantella Community Resources - ostim action of the same name. Offered only to NPCs intimate with you (decided by the Hub). Handled by this module, which asks the player first; the file name stays so the Community Resources action is replaced.

source.description: The one NPC who starts the scene.

prompt:
ANIMATION TRIGGER: starts a sex scene with the player. Use it when the player clearly asks for sex now or clearly agrees to it. Only the player's own clear yes in this conversation counts; an NPC's wish or an event line is not enough. Never name a child. Do not use it for flirting, for talk about sex some other time, or while a sex scene is already running. During a kiss, hug, dance or other affection scene it is fine: that scene ends first.

If it applies, begin your response with '{key}:'.
